clues: This city sits in a low valley in the heart of South Korea. High hills and a wide river frame it on each side.
Its year splits in two: wet, hot summers, then cold, dry winters, shaped by monsoon rains.
New state jobs came here from the far capital in the 1980s. In 1989 it won full big-city status.
In 1993 it hosted a world expo, the kind of huge fair kids still love to picture.
It is home to KAIST, a science and tech school known across the land. Big research labs for Samsung and LG work here too.
